## Wave 7 Summary

Wave 7 lands the three S99-G8-derived JWST-LRD gates: (W7-1, item 18) the substrate-side selection-function folding wrapper that conditions every demographic comparison on the Rinaldi ≲25% color-cut capture floor; (W7-2, item 17) the OPEN side of the seeding fork — whether GGE acoustic interference self-organizing through the a₂^{ζ} channel yields a compact relay-pattern attractor of M_seed ~ 10⁵ M⊙ under gas-dynamical collapse with NO DM-annihilation power source, at the Pacucci DCBH host abundance; (W7-3, item 19) the two-axis joint structure-timing constraint (PANORAMIC quiescent abundance [decisive] × σ_CV clustering [MILD]; Whitler both-ends UV excess × steep α), selection-folded through W7-1's wrapper. Carry-forward source: the S99 litreview campaign G8 paired reports (V.1/V.5–V.9 little-red-dots specs; V.2–V.4 mack specs), consolidated in `session-99-litreview-consolidated-gen-physicist.md` §II items 17–19.

## Wave 7 Wall Law (governing fact — MANDATORY in every block)

`LRD_demographics_not_discriminating` (closed mechanism, **STAGING**, `sessions/framework/registry/closed-gw-channels.md`; verified via knowledge MCP 2026-06-06): LRD/structure demographics **CANNOT discriminate the framework from ΛCDM at z < 10²⁸**. Every source paper in this wave observes at z ≈ 3–16 — **~28 OOM below the wall** in (1+z). All three gates are therefore **consistency ceilings / joint constraints, explicitly INFO-by-design in discriminating power**: a PASS is consistency only, NEVER a framework-vs-ΛCDM discriminator; a FAIL (an axis missed by >1σ after selection folding, or a collapse that demands an energy source the substrate does not have) IS a real constraint on substrate assembly. W7-3's EXPECTED verdict is INFO (degenerate-with-ΛCDM below the wall). The lone wall-escaping G8 discriminator — the SMDS seeding fork (paper 06 Ilie), which tests the DM INTERACTION property (annihilating vs non-annihilating), not assembly counts — is a `mack-cosmic-bridge` falsifier-master-inventory registry row routed **in-session** (context §"Covered elsewhere", G8-1); it is NOT a Wave-7 gate and MUST NOT be duplicated here.

## §W7-1. S100b-SELECTION-FUNCTION-FLOOR (item 18)

**Wall law (mandatory paragraph)**: `LRD_demographics_not_discriminating` STAGING — LRD/structure demographics cannot discriminate the framework from ΛCDM at z < 10²⁸; the Rinaldi source paper observes at z ≈ 3–9, ~28 OOM below the wall. This gate is a **consistency-infrastructure gate, explicitly INFO-by-design in discriminating power**: it produces the selection-folded comparison band every demographic gate must use; it discriminates NOTHING between the framework and ΛCDM. Its PASS criterion is artifact-correctness (wrapper reproduces the published Rinaldi capture floor on the published test case), not a physics discrimination. The wall-escaping SMDS fork is mack's in-session registry row, not this gate.

```yaml
# ---- Identity ----
gate_id: "S100b-SELECTION-FUNCTION-FLOOR"
schema_version: "R3"
trigger: "[VERIFY]"
classification: "NON-PHONONIC"   # observational-methodology constraint (litrev G8 §II.6: selection systematics WIDEN the substrate-allowed space; no substrate excitation content)
agent_type: "little-red-dots-jwst-analyst"

wave_class: "COMPUTE"            # M2 FAILS for METHODOLOGY-class: .py producing script with a numerical reproduction comparison; no methodology-wave-allowlist entry applies (declared per wave-classification.md strict conjunction)
verdict_source: "computations/session-100b/s100b_gate_verdicts.txt"

method:
  description: >
    Two-part deliverable. (a) REUSABLE WRAPPER MODULE computations/_shared/s100b_selection_fold.py:
    fold(n_intrinsic(z), S(z)) = n_intrinsic(z)*S(z) [intrinsic -> observable];
    unfold(n_observed(z), S_band) -> intrinsic band [n_obs/S_max, n_obs/S_min] with
    S_band = [S_floor, 1.0]; per-z S_i(z) loaded from the Rinaldi extraction where
    recoverable, flat S_floor = 0.25 otherwise. (b) GATE SCRIPT
    computations/session-100b/s100b_w7_selection_function_floor.py: extracts the
    published Rinaldi test case from fetched text (read_arxiv_paper("2604.07138");
    direct PDF Read is blocked — the S99 litrev precedent), runs the wrapper on the
    published inclusive-sample counts (598 GOODS-S + 218 GOODS-N) vs the
    classic-extreme-color-cut sub-sample, and verifies the wrapper-computed global
    capture fraction against the published <=25% figure. Emits the z-gridded
    selection-folded band npz consumed downstream. Per feedback_research-corpus:
    test-case numerals from fetched sources ONLY; an extraction failure is a
    DECLARED PIN GAP routed to the INFO branch, never memory-fill.
  producing_script: "computations/session-100b/s100b_w7_selection_function_floor.py"
  wrapper_module: "computations/_shared/s100b_selection_fold.py"

# ---- PRDR Checklist (8 items) ----
# (1) operator
operator:
  type: "inequality (reproduction test) + artifact-existence (wrapper + npz)"
  form: "|capture_wrapper - capture_published| / capture_published <= 0.10  AND  capture_wrapper <= 0.25 + 0.05  AND  importable wrapper module exists  AND  band npz exists with z-grid + S-band + W(z) arrays"

# (2) strict_PASS_boundary
strict_PASS_boundary:
  value: "rel deviation 0.10 on capture_published (published at ~2 sig figs => rel_tol >= 1e-2 satisfied per Class 8.3); absolute guard capture_wrapper <= 0.30"
  direction: "<="

# (3) boundary_reachable_analytically
boundary_reachable_analytically:
  bool: false
  proof_ref: "null — capture_published is an empirical published value (Rinaldi arXiv 2604.07138), not an analytic derivation; the 0.10 rel tolerance is the Class-8.3 publication-precision-tolerant pin"

# (4) reachable_rationals
reachable_rationals:
  includes_integer_mesh: false
  mesh_density: "continuous on capture in (0,1]; z-grid 101 points"

# (5) machinery_pin_map
machinery_pin_map:

  L_max: "N/A — no spectral truncation (laboratory-IN selection arithmetic)"
  scan_range: "z in [3.0, 13.0]; S in [0.25, 1.0]"
  step_size: "dz = 0.1"
  tolerance: "0.10 relative (reproduction); 0.30 absolute capture guard"
  scheme: "SELECTION-FOLD-RINALDI"
  convention: "CAPTURE-FRACTION-MULTIPLICATIVE"   # n_obs = S * n_int; unfold divides
  random_seed: "N/A — deterministic"
  GPU_path: "cpu-cap-OMP8"                     # scalar/grid arithmetic; no large linalg
  capture_floor_global: 0.25                   # Rinaldi "classic extreme color cuts isolate only <=25%"
  S_band: "[0.25, 1.0]"                        # classic-cut floor .. inclusive unity
  extraction_protocol: "read_arxiv_paper(paper_id='2604.07138') fetched text; per-z S_i(z) + classic-vs-inclusive counts; PDF bytes SHA-pinned as provenance (Read-blocked binary)"
  inclusive_counts_published: "598 (GOODS-S) + 218 (GOODS-N), ~349 arcmin^2 JADES"
  prior_work_anchor: "CLUST-43 — computations/session-43/s43_lrd_clustering.{py,npz,png} ON DISK (verified at plan-freeze); gate LRD-CLUST-43 INFO; knowledge-MCP provenance edge s43_lrd_clustering.py --feeds_into--> CLUST-43; batch-migrated S81 (T3-BATCH-S43-LRD-CLUSTERING: INFO, value=MIGRATED). The wrapper composes with (does not modify) that clustering machinery; W7-3 reuses both."
  publication_precision: "3 sig figs (S(z), W(z) published values); npz carries float64 — downstream verifiers load npz, not WP text (Class 8.3 round-trip)"

# (6) audit_discriminators
audit_discriminators:
  audit_sha256_inputs: ["producing_script", "wrapper_module", "input_pin_map (Rinaldi PDF sha + litrev shas + canonical_constants runtime sha)", "machinery_pin_map"]
  content_sha256_inputs: ["producing_script"]

# (7) substitution_chain — direction claim: the floor WIDENS the intrinsic band upward by >= 0.602 dex
substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    Claim: "folding through the Rinaldi capture floor widens the intrinsic-abundance
            band UPWARD by at least a factor 4 (= +0.602 dex) for classic-cut-selected samples"
    Definition 1: S_i(z) = capture fraction = P(true LRD at z enters the classic-cut sample)
                  [Rinaldi 2604.07138, fetched text; published floor S <= 0.25]
    Definition 2: n_obs(z) = S(z) * n_int(z)        [selection convolution, definition of capture]
    Substitute:   n_int(z) = n_obs(z) / S(z)
    Simplify:     S(z) <= 0.25  =>  1/S(z) >= 4
    Canonical form: n_int(z) >= 4 * n_obs(z) at the classic-cut floor
    Direction:    widening factor W = 1/S >= 4; log10(4) = 0.602 => intrinsic band
                  extends UPWARD by >= 0.602 dex relative to the bare observed value
    Conclusion:   every abundance comparison against a classic-cut-selected LF carries
                  a >= 0.6 dex upward widening on the intrinsic side; a bare-LF comparison
                  without this fold is an INVALID TEST (the Rinaldi discipline).

The wrapper lands with the bound-form floor S <= 0.25 only (global figure per the litrev spot-verification), flagged for re-verification; downstream gates consume the flat-floor band. # (7) substitution_chain — three pre-registered directional chains
substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    --- Chain 17-1 (X-ray-ceiling diagnostic; direction: BELOW) ---
    Claim: "the Eddington-limited luminosity of a 10^5 M_sun seed sits BELOW the
            Sacchi stacked ceiling 3e43 erg/s"
    Step 1: L_Edd = 1.3e38 * (M/M_sun) erg/s     [canonical Eddington relation;
            memory guard: M/M_sun, NOT M/1e8]
    Step 2: M_seed = 1e5 M_sun                    [Pacucci DCBH initial seed; C1 band center]
    Step 3: L_Edd(M_seed) = 1.3e38 * 1e5 = 1.3e43 erg/s
    Step 4: ratio = L_Edd / L_ceiling = 1.3e43 / 3.0e43 = 0.433
    Step 5: 0.433 < 1  =>  L_Edd(M_seed) < L_ceiling
    Conclusion: an Eddington-limited 10^5 M_sun seed is X-ray-stack-consistent by a
            factor ~2.3 BEFORE Compton-thick self-screening (N_H ~ n*L >= 1e25 cm^-2
            at the Pacucci core: 3.16e7 cm^-3 x ~3 pc x 3.086e18 cm/pc ~ 3e26 cm^-2).

    --- Chain 17-2 (seed-mass route; direction: IN-BAND) ---
    Claim: "isothermal collapse at the atomic-cooling floor, capped by the GR
            instability, lands M_seed inside [10^4.5, 10^5.5] M_sun at the fiducial"
    Step 1: c_s = sqrt(gamma k_B T / (mu m_H)), gamma = 5/3, T = 8000 K, mu = 1.22
    Step 2: c_s = sqrt(1.667*1.381e-16*8000/(1.22*1.673e-24)) = 9.5e5 cm/s = 9.5 km/s
    Step 3: Mdot = alpha c_s^3/G = 0.975*(9.5e5)^3/6.674e-8 = 1.25e25 g/s ~ 0.20 M_sun/yr
    Step 4: M(t_SMS) = Mdot * t_SMS = 0.20 * 1.0e6 = 2.0e5 M_sun     [t_SMS = 1 Myr fiducial]
    Step 5: M_GR = 3.0e5 M_sun   [Ilie <Gamma_1>_P < 4/3 + 2.5*GM/(Rc^2), n=3 non-rotating]
    Step 6: M_seed = min(M(t_SMS), M_GR) * f_prompt = min(2.0e5, 3.0e5) * 1.0 = 2.0e5 M_sun
    Canonical form: log10(M_seed/M_sun) = 5.30
    Direction: 4.5 <= 5.30 <= 5.5  =>  inside the pre-registered band
    Conclusion: the gas-dynamical a_2-channel route lands the seed in-band with NO
            annihilation term; diagnostic corners (t_SMS = 2 Myr -> min(4.0e5, 3.0e5)
            = 3.0e5 = 10^5.48 in-band; f_prompt = 0.1 -> 10^4.30 BELOW band, reported
            as the Ilie prompt-floor diagnostic, NOT gated). The Jeans floor
            M_J(8000 K, 10^7.5 cm^-3) ~ 9e3 M_sun << M_seed confirms monolithic
            (accretion-fed), not single-clump, growth.

    --- Chain 17-3 (host-abundance sufficiency; direction: SUFFICIENT) ---
    Claim: "the emergent a_2-channel Friedmann growth sources atomic-cooling-halo
            abundance SUFFICIENT for the observed selection-folded LRD density"
    Step 1: n_ACH(z) = integral_{M_ACH(z)} (dn/dM) dM, Sheth-Tormen on the borrowed
            Planck-2018 baseline; M_ACH(z) from T_vir(M, z) = 1e4 K with
            T_vir = (mu_vir m_H/2 k_B) * (G M H(z) sqrt(Delta_c/2))^{2/3}
            [virial theorem + spherical collapse, first-principles; mu_vir = 0.6]
    Step 2: at z = 6-10 the script computes n_ACH; OOM expectation 1e-2..1e0 cMpc^-3
            (M_ACH ~ few x 1e7 M_sun halos are abundant)
    Step 3: n_LRD_folded <= (1e-5..1e-4) / S with S >= 0.25  =>  <= 4e-4 cMpc^-3
    Step 4: f_req = n_LRD_folded / n_ACH ~ (1e-5..4e-4)/(1e-2..1e0) = 1e-5..4e-2
    Direction: f_req << 1  =>  hosts SUFFICE; surplus absorbed by the sub-unity
            pristine/LW-synchronization efficiency (external, <= 1 by construction)
    Conclusion: C2b passes iff f_req <= 1 as computed; the falsifiable direction is
            f_req > 1 (substrate cannot independently source the hosts -> INFO branch).

## §W7-3. S100b-STRUCTURE-TIMING-TWO-AXIS (item 19)

**Wall law (mandatory paragraph)**: `LRD_demographics_not_discriminating` STAGING — LRD/structure demographics cannot discriminate the framework from ΛCDM at z < 10²⁸; PANORAMIC observes z ≈ 3–8 and Whitler z ≈ 9–16, ~28 OOM below the wall. This gate is a **joint constraint / consistency ceiling, explicitly INFO-by-design**: its **EXPECTED verdict is INFO** (degenerate-with-ΛCDM below the wall). A PASS means both axes are hit simultaneously inside the selection-folded band — **still non-discriminating, consistency only, never a framework-vs-ΛCDM discriminator** (an efficient-baryon ΛCDM model hits the same bands). A FAIL — either axis missed by >1σ after selection folding — IS a real constraint on substrate assembly and hands a watchlist row to mack (sole writer; this gate touches no registry). The wall-escaping SMDS fork is mack's in-session row — do not duplicate. **Spot-verification correction carried (both litrev reports, MANDATORY)**: the clustering axis is MILD ("only at low significance" / "mild tension" — the paper's own language; the σ_CV = 0.7±0.3 error bar overlaps the mock 0.43–0.51 band at ~0.6σ); the sweep index overstated it as a "decisive second fingerprint." **The abundance axis carries the weight.** Also corrected: Whitler φ* decline z~10→13 is ~2.1–2.3 (PDF-verified), not the index's "~3"; α was index-truncated, PDF-verified to −2.36..−2.60.

```yaml
# ---- Identity ----
gate_id: "S100b-STRUCTURE-TIMING-TWO-AXIS"
schema_version: "R3"
trigger: "[VERIFY]"
classification: "PHONONIC"       # assembly IS the GGE interference pattern self-organizing through the a_2 channel; spatially correlated BY CONSTRUCTION (coherent post-transit standing wave, not Poisson-sampled halos) — the a_2/GEOMETRIC channel flavor is noted in framing
agent_type: "little-red-dots-jwst-analyst"   # mack-cosmic-bridge lands any watchlist row on FAIL (sole-writer surface untouched by this gate)
hypothesis: "The substrate assembly band (a_2-channel GGE interference self-organization, baryonic efficiency unpinned below the wall, selection-folded through W7-1) simultaneously contains BOTH axes of BOTH papers — (PANORAMIC) >=1 dex quiescent-abundance excess [DECISIVE] AND sigma_CV ~ 0.7+-0.3 clustering [MILD]; (Whitler/JADES) both-ends UV excess AND steep alpha = -2.36..-2.60 — with the EXPECTED outcome INFO (degenerate-with-LCDM below z = 10^28)."
wave_class: "COMPUTE"
verdict_source: "computations/session-100b/s100b_gate_verdicts.txt"

method:
  description: >
    Pre-register + evaluate the two-axis joint constraint, selection-folded. Axes:
    A1 ABUNDANCE (PANORAMIC, DECISIVE) — observed gold n = 1.81e-5 (z=3-3.5) declining
    to 0.07e-5 (z=6-8) Mpc^-3; gold/silver 1.5/3.1e-5 at z=3-4; >=1 dex above the
    empirical-model/simulation envelope. Evaluate against (i) the model-envelope floor
    and (ii) the MAXIMAL-ASSEMBLY ceiling n_max(M* >= 1e10, z) = n_halo(M_h >= M*/(f_b*eps), z)
    at eps = 1 (the baryon-budget bound that caps ANY assembly, substrate included),
    Sheth-Tormen on the borrowed Planck-2018 baseline, all selection-folded via the
    W7-1 wrapper (HARD input).
    A2 CLUSTERING (PANORAMIC, MILD) — sigma_CV_obs = 0.7+-0.3 vs UniverseMachine mocks
    0.43 (sSFR-matched) / 0.51 (halo-mass-matched). Compute the substrate-side
    sigma_CV(b) on the single-NIRCam-pointing scale via the CLUST-43 machinery
    (sigma_CV^2 ~ b^2 sigma_DM^2(V_pointing); growth factor + xi_DM from
    s43_lrd_clustering.py, reused not rewritten); invert the observed band into an
    implied-bias band; direction check: the standing-wave construction predicts
    sigma_CV >= mock (over-clustering). Significance statement pre-computed: nearest-
    edge tension (0.7-0.51)/0.3 = 0.63 sigma — MILD, cannot reject at 1 sigma in the
    over-clustering direction (the substitution chain below).
    B1 BOTH-ENDS UV (Whitler) — rho_UV(z~10) = 2.82(+0.34/-0.33)e25 erg/s/Hz/Mpc^3;
    phi* decline ~2.1-2.3 (z~10->13, PDF-verified); bright M_UV <= -20 slow decline AND
    faint -18..-17 over-abundance: evaluate both-end Phi bins (extracted at runtime
    from fetched text, read_arxiv_paper('2501.00984')) against the [model-envelope,
    eps=1 ceiling] band with rho_UV,max = f_b * eps * (baryon accretion) / kappa_UV.
    B2 STEEP ALPHA (Whitler) — alpha_obs band [-2.79, -2.16] (Schechter -2.36 -0.18/+0.20
    to DPL -2.60 -0.19/+0.17 at z~10; z~13: -2.29/-2.41). The substrate emits a
    DIRECTIONAL prediction only (efficient fragmentation to small scales => faint-end
    dominance, alpha <= -2); no quantitative substrate alpha exists — B2 is a
    set-membership + direction check, feeding INFO not PASS on its own.
    JOINT ENCODING — per-paper logical AND, then across papers: PASS iff the substrate
    FIDUCIAL (maximal-coherence reading: high-end efficiency + over-clustering
    direction) hits all four axes within 1 sigma (selection-folded); INFO iff every
    axis lies inside the substrate's ALLOWED band (model-envelope..eps=1 ceiling,
    folded) without the fiducial hitting all four — the degenerate-with-LCDM EXPECTED
    outcome; FAIL iff ANY axis lies > 1 sigma OUTSIDE the maximal folded band (a real
    constraint no efficiency choice rescues). The MILD-axis weighting is explicit: A2
    can only fire FAIL in the UNDER-clustering direction (> 1 sigma below mocks),
    since the observed band overlaps the mocks from above.
    PDF-verified pins re-verified at runtime against fetched text; extraction failure
    on any pinned numeral = declared pin gap routed per-axis (axis drops to bound-form
    evaluation, disclosed), never memory-fill (feedback_research-corpus).
  producing_script: "computations/session-100b/s100b_w7_structure_timing_two_axis.py"

# ---- PRDR Checklist (8 items) ----
# (1) operator
operator:
  type: "conjunctive set-membership over 4 axes with 3-tier banding (fiducial-hit / band-contained / band-excluded)"
  form: "PASS: all 4 axes |fiducial - obs| <= 1 sigma_obs (folded); INFO: all 4 axes obs in [envelope_lo, eps1_ceiling]_folded; FAIL: any axis obs > 1 sigma outside [envelope_lo, eps1_ceiling]_folded (A2 FAIL-direction = under-clustering only)"

  direction: "<= (per-axis distance); conjunctive AND across axes"

  A1_abundance_pins: "gold n: 1.81e-5 (z=3-3.5) -> 0.07e-5 (z=6-8) Mpc^-3; gold/silver 1.5/3.1e-5 (z=3-4); >=1 dex model underprediction at z>~4 (arXiv 2604.05022, 34 sightlines, 101 gold + 137 silver massive M* >= 1e10)"

# (7) substitution_chain — two pre-registered chains (MILD-axis significance; eps=1 ceiling direction)
substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    --- Chain 19-1 (clustering axis is MILD; direction: OVERLAP at < 1 sigma) ---
    Claim: "the observed sigma_CV 1-sigma interval overlaps the mock band, so the
            clustering axis cannot reject at 1 sigma — MILD, not decisive"
    Step 1: sigma_CV_obs = 0.7 +- 0.3      [PANORAMIC arXiv 2604.05022, PDF-verified]
    Step 2: sigma_CV_mock in [0.43, 0.51]  [UniverseMachine sSFR- / halo-mass-matched]
    Step 3: lower 1-sigma edge = 0.7 - 0.3 = 0.4
    Step 4: 0.4 < 0.43 <= 0.51  =>  [0.4, 1.0] intersect [0.43, 0.51] is non-empty
    Step 5: nearest-edge tension = (0.7 - 0.51)/0.3 = 0.63 sigma < 1 sigma
    Conclusion: the clustering axis carries ~0.6 sigma tension — directionally
            substrate-favorable (standing-wave over-clustering) but NON-decisive;
            the abundance axis (>= 1 dex) carries the joint constraint's weight.
            [This is the litrev spot-verification correction, carried as mandated.]

    --- Chain 19-2 (maximal-assembly ceiling; direction: PASS-side iff obs below ceiling) ---
    Claim: "the eps = 1 baryon-budget ceiling bounds ANY assembly (substrate included);
            FAIL fires only if a folded observed axis exceeds it by > 1 sigma"
    Step 1: M_h_min(eps) = M* / (f_b * eps);  f_b = Omega_b/Omega_m = 0.0493/0.315 = 0.1565
            [canonical imports, lines 88-89]
    Step 2: eps = 1 (maximal)  =>  M_h_min = 1e10 / 0.1565 = 6.39e10 M_sun
    Step 3: n_max(z) = integral_{M_h_min} (dn/dM) dM   [Sheth-Tormen, borrowed baseline]
    Step 4: compare n_obs,folded(z-bin) <= n_max(z) per bin (A1); analogously
            rho_UV,obs <= rho_UV,max = f_b * eps * dM_acc/dt / kappa_UV (B1)
    Direction: obs BELOW ceiling = inside the allowed band (INFO-side);
               obs > 1 sigma ABOVE ceiling = band-excluded (FAIL-side)
    Conclusion: the FAIL branch is reserved for a violation no efficiency choice
            rescues — the real-constraint reading the wall law protects.

The two-axis joint constraint is ENCODED and LIVE as a consistency ceiling; it sharpens only with more sightlines (A2) or deeper LFs (B1/B2), not with framework-side work. ## Wave 7 → Session Decision Point

Wave 7 is the final 100b wave; outcomes route to session close + next-session planning:

- **W7-1 PASS** → wrapper canonical for all future demographic gates; W7-3 dispatches. **W7-1 FAIL** → W7-3 closes PRE-REG-INC (mechanical closure, DPP pre-declared); W7-2 C2b exercises mode-B; wrapper remediation = 4-field carry-forward. **W7-1 INFO** (extraction-limited) → downstream gates consume the flat-floor band; re-verification carry-forward.
- **W7-2 PASS** → gas-dynamical seeding fork stays OPEN with the emergent chain exercised end-to-end at a new observable (consistency only, wall law); mack's SMDS row cites the OPEN-side status. **W7-2 FAIL** (C3) → Track-B 0.9: energy-source gap is a genuine Q1 math/physics adjudication candidate for `/rclab-investigate` (two readings: a₂-budget insufficiency vs collapse-route mis-specification). **W7-2 INFO** → host-sourcing question routes to the structure-timing surface; no energy-track update.
- **W7-3 INFO (EXPECTED)** → joint constraint encoded + live as a consistency ceiling; no registry action. **W7-3 PASS** → recorded SATISFIED-DEGENERATE; explicitly NOT a discriminator (wall law). **W7-3 FAIL** → mack-cosmic-bridge lands the watchlist row (sole writer); failed axis becomes a fresh-EVOI carry-forward.
- No downstream 100b wave consumes Wave-7 outputs; cross-references from mack's in-session registry batch (SMDS row) cite gate verdicts by audit_sha256 from `computations/session-100b/s100b_gate_verdicts.txt`.
